description: This PHP source file defines the SubpanelMerge class, which extends ListViewMerge. The class handles merging metadata for subpanels in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including loading, transforming, and saving subpanel configuration data.

classes.name: SubpanelMerge
classes.description: A class for merging subpanel metadata in SuiteCRM, extending ListViewMerge, with methods for loading, transforming, merging, and saving subpanel configurations.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads metadata from original, new, and custom files, transforming them into a structure suitable for merging.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Sets the list_fields in mergeData to the result of buildPanels, preparing merged panel configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the merged metadata to a specified file.
